units.time: milliseconds per complete invocation (one query batch)

metadata.protocol: One warm-up per method/workload; fresh preparation every timed call; at least five repeats; medians of per-call batch durations. Short calls aggregated, up to 200 calls per repeat. Timing excludes input generation, validation, aggregation, memory tracing and rendering. Per-call clock overhead remains included. Method order rotated by workload.
metadata.memory_protocol: Separate fresh tracemalloc run for each method/version/workload. Input and queries allocated before tracing; prepared structures and returned output retained at reading. Reports current and peak traced Python bytes, not process RSS or mathematical auxiliary space. No native-memory completeness claim.
